And I can ask Dr. Schmidt if she has any suggestions for community leaders we could interview too!

That's perfect, Maria! I love how this is coming together. Let's also make sure to check if the library has any books or articles on local movements. Oh, and I'll bring the materials Isabella mentioned too. See you at 5:30pm in the library!
